# pvecli storage remove

Remove a storage definition. The data on the backend is left untouched.

```text
pvecli storage remove [STORAGE_ID] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `STORAGE_ID` | Storage ID to remove. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
